commands: which ruff; ruff --version 2>/dev/null; echo "---toolcache---"; ls /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/*/x64/bin/ruff 2>/dev/null; ls /home/runner/work/_temp/prflow-lint-bin/ruff 2>/dev/null && /home/runner/work/_temp/prflow-lint-bin/ruff --version 2>/dev/null
find /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python -name ruff -path '*/bin/*' 2>/dev/null; python3 -m ruff --version 2>/dev/null; pip show ruff 2>/dev/null | grep -i version

python3 -c "import importlib.util,os; s=importlib.util.find_spec('ruff'); print(os.path.dirname(s.origin))" 2>/dev/null; find /opt/hostedtoolcache/Python/3.11.16 -name 'ruff' -type f 2>/dev/null | head
git ls-files '*.py' > .prflow/tmp/pyfiles.txt; ruff check --no-force-exclude .prflow/tmp/pyfiles.txt 2>&1 | tail; echo "note: passing the list file, not the files"

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/2003/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true); echo "trigger=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"; if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --r …[per-command-truncated]

rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/implement-active-2003" || true; rm -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)/.prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-2003.md" || true; echo cleaned
